T001.label: AI adoption and its effects on learning
T001.description: Patterns of student AI adoption and effects on learning, critical thinking, skills and student behavior.
T001.distinguish_from: Use T003 when concrete teaching decisions or classroom implementation are central. Use T004 when cheating or detection is central. Campus administration alone does not establish this theme.

T002.label: School AI restrictions, privacy, and policy
T002.description: Institutional decisions about permitted AI use in schools and universities, including governance, restrictions, privacy and consent.
T002.distinguish_from: A policy announcement remains T002 even when cheating motivates it. A teacher describing an assignment is usually T003. Training to understand AI is T005 when that is the main focus.

T003.label: Classroom AI implementation and teacher practice
T003.description: Concrete educator practices and classroom decisions about teaching, assignments, assessment and implementation of AI tools.
includes: Classroom uses of AI in subject teaching
Educator accounts of implementing or limiting AI
T003.distinguish_from: Teaching a subject with AI differs from teaching people about AI itself (T005). District policy development is T002. Broad effects on student learning are T001.

T004.label: Academic integrity, cheating, and AI detection
T004.description: Academic honesty involving AI, including cheating, plagiarism, AI-written assessment work, detection reliability and integrity enforcement.
includes: False positives and limitations of AI detectors
T004.distinguish_from: Higher marks on undetected AI-written work are not evidence of improved learning. A broad institutional policy story may be T002; choose the central subject rather than a passing mention of cheating.

T005.label: AI literacy and educational resources
T005.description: Helping students and educators understand, evaluate and use AI responsibly through literacy instruction, training and educational resources.
includes: Understanding AI limitations and verifying outputs
Educator training and shared understanding of responsible AI use
T005.distinguish_from: Using AI to teach English or mathematics is T003 when subject teaching is central. Training whose main purpose is professional AI use outside education does not automatically fit this theme.
